methodology_notes: Point-in-time constituent list documenting S&P 100 components at the start of the 2014-2024 research sample. Membership is frozen permanently at start-of-sample. Securities that later merged, restructured, or delisted (e.g. APC, EMC, MON, RTN, TWX, UTX, WAG) are preserved without forward-filling or survivorship-filtering. Tickers with exchange dot symbols (e.g., BRK.B) are mapped to standard Yahoo Finance format (BRK-B) in the data loader.
